decision: The narrowed candidate-specific executed history-page algorithm/allocation-work concern is accounted for: no production read-path delta was found. This is sufficient bounded read-path evidence for eventual local I03 qualification when remaining mandatory gates pass. Raw timing remains MIXED_OR_INDETERMINATE; no latency-equivalence or improvement assertion follows.
causal_basis: Independently read TaskHistoryService.page and TaskCapsuleStore.read_index. Page only validates cursor/manifest, scans canonical summaries, validates/sorts/hashes those rows and slices the response. It does not enter capsule session recovery/commit or history._entry.

The sole writer edge is read_index stored-index mismatch -> unchanged atomic_write_json -> changed atomic_write_bytes. The writer synchronously writes/flushes/fsyncs nonempty index bytes before success and propagates failure. Four successful fixed captures, stable initial/final seed-index proof, and zero page-interval native write operations/transfers jointly exclude this changed writer from the measured page path. This is combined static/observational reasoning, not direct call instrumentation.

All remaining IO imports/global statements/read helpers are AST-identical, history/store files byte-identical, selected loaded49/50 Orqalis files equal, exact current dependencies and canonical fixture/order/work equal. There is no concrete changed executed path implementing additional candidate canonical-read validation, sorting, response allocation or filesystem scanning.

Same unchanged reference R1/R2 exhibits large wall/CPU drift. This proves temporal variation exists even without a production source change; it does not establish a named scheduler/cache/allocator/security-agent cause or quantify how much candidate excess each mechanism explains.
master52_53_interpretation: Accepted I03 requires correct bounded pagination and measured byte/latency costs, not a prospectively declared universal no-higher history SLO. Master53 should still reject identified feature-induced unexplained degradation; the static executed-path proof accounts for the source-level concern raised by this mixed block. Unknown exact runtime/host cause is retained as a measurement limit, not a fabricated production gap. This record does not certify whole convergence; two complete iterations and independent disposition of execution/richer-store/memory/UI costs remain mandatory.
raw_timing_limits: Both candidates remain slower than R1; C2 exceeds R2 whole p95/max and some traversal tails. All signed differences versus BOTH references remain unchanged and linked in prior raw/independent review.

Cannot claim identical every interpreter allocation, universal physical IO, host idleness, native timing equivalence, historical cause, absence of all possible future performance problems, or that raw no-higher rule passed.
Old195/663/334/current302 medians and17.46/23.4s tails, invalid profiler and failed harness records remain retained.
No new timing, warmup, profile, modified threshold, reference selection or adaptive diagnostic is warranted without a concrete changed executed path or new reproducible failure.
